summary: All four iteration-1 HALT defects are confirmed resolved: Fardet 2014 PMID 24782338 now correctly reports 93% sensitivity / 86% specificity; the Hindawi Dignass ref [2] has been removed and its claims redistributed to whitelisted sources; the athlete prevalence figure is softened to qualitative language with no unsupported numeric anchor; and the Henter Blood 2024 figures are corrected to the ≥500 µg/L criterion with 97.1%/99.5% across 4 validation datasets at PMID 39046779. All 9 bibliography entries carry full tag and tier suffixes, bib is sequential 1-9 with no gaps, no bare inline citations, every whitelist host check passes, and no unverifiable numeric claim remains. Total 97, above the 92 threshold.
